title: Fly a drone from the Device page, with live video | VirtualPyTest
description:
A Tello drone is a device like any other in VirtualPyTest. From the Device page you see the paired drone, open its live camera, take control and fly it with the remote: take off, rotate, climb, descend and land.

The same controller is used by the test scripts. A later video shows an AI agent working with the drone.

Open source & free
